hypothesis: Use predictions to rank feasible destinations rather than only vetoing 80% crossings. Existing inspected log has 508 multi-destination groups and 130 different current/forecast best-fit rankings; repeated checks are not independent moves.
control: Shared numeric demand-source/destination packing, select highest prospective current CPU among physically suitable hosts below the same current-demand threshold; host-ID tie break.
candidate: Only LR ranks by summed frozen per-VM five-minute forecasts instead of current CPU. Same current-demand admission threshold, physical CPU/RAM/BW/storage and all other decisions. No forecast veto in ranking mode.
model: Frozen robust/persistence per VM, historical samples only, no parameter tuning or future workload reads.
inputs: Five inspected development cases, no reserved data; 24-hour mixed jobs.
acceptance: separate shared best-fit improvement from predictive increment
do not claim a universal winner
